notes: אִם takes the fronted *Was* as the question auxiliary the ASV wrote for it, a present function morpheme taking the English its sense carries (rules 11, 17); leaving אִם unrepresented and giving *Was* to the Niphal יֵרָאֶה as its passive auxiliary is the competing reading. The presentative dummy *there* stays with the finite verb.

The construction-supplied copula of *Then was war in the gates* joins the nominal anchor לָחֶם; giving it instead to the locative שְׁעָרִים was the competing reading, and no preposition morpheme stands there to take it under rule 49.
שְׁעָרִים takes the supplied *in* by its case-function and the supplied *the* by the nominal expression (rules 33, 15).
